name: psyai
description: PsyAI - local-first Windows desktop application for counseling, simulation, and resonance workflows.

scripts.start: npm run build --silent && npm run start -w src/desktop-electron
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared --silent && npm run build:contracts --silent && npm run build:app-state --silent && npm run build -w src/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared --silent && npm run build:contracts --silent && npm run build:app-state --silent && npm run build:counseling --silent && npm run build:simulation --silent && npm run build:resonance --silent && npm run build:reporting --silent && npm run build:runtime --silent && npm run build:infrastructure --silent && npm run build -w src/backend
scripts.build:desktop-electron: npm run build:frontend --silent && npm run build:backend --silent && npm run build -w src/desktop-electron
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:contracts && npm run build:app-state && npm run build:counseling && npm run build:simulation && npm run build:resonance && npm run build:reporting && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:infrastructure && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:desktop-electron
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Automated tests are not included in this source release. Use npm run check instead.')"
scripts.smoke:assembly: node -e "console.log('Smoke tests are not included in this source release.')"
scripts.smoke:real: node -e "console.log('Smoke tests are not included in this source release.')"
scripts.smoke:real:resonance: node -e "console.log('Smoke tests are not included in this source release.')"
